about: Written by e2er at export (2026-10-15) from what the run recorded: the scripts that wrote estimation_results.json, from the estimation script on, in the order the run ran them (its script log); the files they read; and the packages they import. code/requirements.txt pins 18 package(s) at the versions the run used.

inputs.source: the study's database, tables: eq_annual_counts (made by the study during the run); eq_bvalue_windows (made by the study during the run); eq_clean_m45 (made by the study during the run); usgs_raw_1976_1985 (ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat), U.S. Geological Survey, earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 and above worldwide, 1976-01-01 to 1986-01-01, loaded 2026-10-14); usgs_raw_1986_1995 (ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat), U.S. Geological Survey, earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 and above worldwide, 1986-01-01 to 1996-01-01, loaded 2026-10-14); usgs_raw_1996_2005 (ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat), U.S. Geological Survey, earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 and above worldwide, 1996-01-01 to 2006-01-01, loaded 2026-10-14); usgs_raw_2006_2015 (ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat), U.S. Geological Survey, earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 and above worldwide, 2006-01-01 to 2016-01-01, loaded 2026-10-14); usgs_raw_2016_2025 (ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat), U.S. Geological Survey, earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 and above worldwide, 2016-01-01 to 2026-01-01, loaded 2026-10-14)
